text:
Talia: Quick thread  putting together a small pricing experiment for next week's webinar. objective: cleaner CTAs + an email-first quote path to capture mid-market leads.
Ben: short summary of changes?
Talia: replace full tariff table with a 3-column clarity grid, swap CTA copy to emphasize estimated cost, and add an optional 'Email me a quote' flow that captures lead intent before demo form.
Iris: suggestion: CTA variants: 'Start free trial', 'Estimate cost', 'Email me a quote'. A/B test Estimate vs Email-first for demo conversion.
Jon: routing for email-first: hidden fields `experiment_tag=pricing_cta_email_may` and `lead_path=email_quote`. HubSpot should add these to contact along with `utm_experiment=cta_emailflow_may`.
SalesBot: note  I can create a follow-up task when `lead_score>=55` and `experiment_tag` present. confirm threshold.
Hannah: 55 OK. also need a short nurture template for emailed quotes (one-liner + CTA to schedule demo). I'll draft.
Ben: estimator design: inline quick calc that returns rounded monthly cost. two modes: InlineEstimate (no email) and EmailQuote (asks email + company size). both client-only; email sent via Mailchimp/HubSpot.
Iris: include analytics events: `estimate_view`, `estimate_run`, `quote_requested`. tie to GA and HobSpot.
Jon: micro-FAQ: collapse answers. Qs: "How do you bill tokens?", "Can I get reserved capacity?", "Does Redwood support VPC/private deployments?" keep one-line answers + 'learn more' links.
Talia: timeline: copy freeze today 5pm PST, dev Wed, QA Thu, soft-launch Fri 10% traffic, escalate if uplift then expand. webinar next Tue.
Ben: metrics: primary = email-quote request rate; secondary = demo scheduling rate from email list, trial starts. segment US/EU.
Iris: accessibility: ensure modal/email form is keyboard accessible, labels, and privacy notice if collecting email.
Hannah: sales micro-brief will include sample outreach, conditions for HS tasks, and the email template.
SalesBot: smoke test plan: when form submit contains `experiment_tag=pricing_cta_email_may`, post to #sales-inbound and create hs_task if `lead_score>=55`. I'll report results.
Talia: ACTIONS: Talia finalize CTAs + microcopy (today), Ben build inline estimator and email form (Wed), Jon configure HubSpot hidden fields and UTMs, Iris wire analytics, Hannah draft nurture and sales snippets.
Talia: thanks all  unless objections i'll push copy to staging tonight. :rocket:
